name: SNAK Venture Partners
identity_check: Confirmed as SNAK Venture Partners (snak.vc; newsletter snakvc.substack.com; LinkedIn company page linkedin.com/company/snakvc, linked from the site: Chicago, IL, founded 2024, type Partnership), the seed fund for marketplaces run by co-founders Sonia Nagar and Adam Koopersmith, both formerly at Pritzker Group Venture Capital. Its own post says it spun out of PGVC in 2024, and EDGAR full-text search shows Form D filings by 'SNAK Venture Partners I LP' (Chicago, IL; Delaware) dated 2024-08-23 and 2025-08-22. Not Pritzker Group Venture Capital (separate file; Pritzker Group is SNAK's anchor LP): companies SNAK lists as 'Prior Investments' (Backlot Cars, G2, Machinery Partner, Coinbase, Cameo and others) were PGVC deals and are not recorded here. Not the SNK/SNEK crypto tokens or other 'Snak' brands that share the name in search results.

thesis_text.value: Seed fund that leads rounds in marketplaces bringing offline, fragmented legacy industries online: construction, logistics, industrial supply, automotive, equipment rental and manufacturing. It looks for post-launch companies with transactions and revenue, founders with deep domain expertise, and markets still run on calls, PDFs and spreadsheets, and diligences them with its own cohort-analysis tool.

open_items: Rounds: only 5 SNAK rounds were found on pages that describe the round (Bloom, Big Rentals, APFusion, RePackify, Ruck), against a Tier A target of 8. SNAK reported 6 investments at the February 2026 fund close and announced Bloom in October 2026, so only about 7 deals are publicly known. Nothing was padded.

Hello Gravel (New Orleans aggregates marketplace) is on SNAK's current portfolio list, but no fetched page describes the round SNAK joined. A search result citing PitchBook mentions a $4M seed on 2026-01-16; PitchBook is login-walled, so this is unverified and not recorded.

The sixth Fund I company (unnamed in the February 2026 release) was not identified. SNAK's portfolio jobs board (marketplacejobs.com/collection/snak-venture-partners) renders client-side and could not be read.
Big Rentals seed: SNAK's post says the round also included 'a strategic industry investor' operating nationally in equipment rentals, without naming it.
application_url: none found. The firm asks founders to email it (address not recorded). SNAK Machine (machine.snak.vc) is a login-gated marketplace analytics tool, not a pitch form.
requires_us_entity: unknown. The firm says it invests 'all over the country' and told TechCrunch it is location-agnostic; every known deal is a US company.
invests_in_indian_founders: not stated anywhere; left out.

Fund I Form D: EDGAR full-text search lists SNAK Venture Partners I LP (CIK 0002015412) with a Form D on 2024-08-23 and a D/A on 2025-08-22, but the filing documents returned 403 to the 'CapitalAtlas research' user agent. Offering amounts were not read, and no other fund was found.

Company details not found on fetched pages: founding year for Ruck, APFusion and RePackify; HQ country for RePackify (its post thanks the Capital Factory accelerator, but that does not establish its HQ).

APFusion sector: no sector id covers the automotive aftermarket or salvage parts, so mobility_ev was assigned by model. Big Rentals (construction and equipment rental) was assigned industrial_manufacturing by model.
stated_sectors: the firm also names construction and automotive, which have no exact sector id; only logistics/supply chain and industrial/manufacturing were mapped.
